observed: vLLM measured vision-tower vs AIC composition (aic_pred_ms), image_px=448, N<=64: max residual +12.709% at N=52; all N<=64 within 12.8%. Matches appendix's stated 'residual up to +12.7% inside the regime'.
claimed: composed forward matches vLLM's own vision tower to within 12.8%
evidence: Thesis (closedloop.tex:869, aiconfigurator.tex:227) explicitly compares AIC composition vs vLLM; DB gives max +12.709% within N<=64. gpt-sol's 12.95% used the wrong operand pair (compiled PyTorch engine, not the AIC composition).
query: WITH aic AS (SELECT DISTINCT n_images,aic_pred_ms FROM collector_encoder_fn WHERE image_px=448 AND aic_pred_ms IS NOT NULL AND is_valid), v AS (SELECT n_images,mean_ms FROM collector_encoder_fn WHERE image_px=448 AND engine='vllm' AND is_valid) SELECT max(100*(v.mean_ms-aic.aic_pred_ms)/aic.aic_pred_ms) FROM aic JOIN v USING(n_images) WHERE v.n_images<=64;
